_note: How each capture is made. capture/all.mjs reads a composition's media.json, finds the captures it uses, and makes the missing ones from here. Demo captures run scripts/demo.ts --group=<group>; the scenes it prints are what compositions place clips by. `grant` is the MCP capabilities a group's scenes need beyond the defaults, held for the run as a person would turn them on (scripts/demo/grant.ts).
